lines.speaker: ANCHOR
lines.text: Good evening. The war is on schedule.

scenes.headline: Ceasefire Enters Second Triumphant Year
scenes.euphemism: “The border has been improved, not moved.”

lines.speaker: ANCHOR
lines.text: The stabilization is proceeding exactly as unplanned.

lines.speaker: ANCHOR
lines.text: Officials describe the operation as special, and stabilization as ongoing.

lines.speaker: ANCHOR
lines.text: Both descriptions have been approved for broadcast.

lines.speaker: NONE
lines.text: The situation is unchanged. It has merely changed 1,140 times.

lines.speaker: CLERK
lines.text: The ceasefire has been approved for expiry.

lines.speaker: CLERK
lines.text: In triplicate. File copy destroyed after reading.

lines.speaker: ANCHOR
lines.text: The facts above are real. The Ministry is not.
